sample_unit: mock scar images (each queried five times per chatbot)

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of chatbots on scar images (keloid vs hypertrophic scar)
links.effect: Overall accuracy of GPT-4 and Bing Chat was 36.0% and 22.0% respectively (P = 0.027); authors conclude technology is not yet sufficient for clinical application standards.
links.quote: The overall accuracy rates of GPT-4 and Bing Chat were 36.0% and 22.0%, respectively (P = 0.027), with GPT-4 showing better performance in terms of specificity for keloids (0.6 vs. 0.006) and hypertrophic scars (0.72 vs. 0.0) than Bing Chat.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of multimodal chat-based LLMs (GPT-4, Bing Chat, Bard) on mock scar images without testing any deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
